ef_inn_keeper: Warm floor, hot water, and Ma Dunnery will sing at you until you decide you like it.
Rooms are short. Six went to the Foundation a month back and I have seen two of them slept in.
ef_inn_surveyor: Geothermal survey. Heat flow, fissure creep, that sort of thing. It is genuinely interesting work.
No, I do not know what is in the crates. I asked once and got a very pleasant answer that was not one.
ef_inn_drover: I bring charcoal up the pass eleven months of the year.
The twelfth the pass is shut, and this city burns its furniture. I have watched it happen.
ef_inn_singer: Every song here is about the same three things. Fire, water, and somebody who did not come home.
We are not a cheerful people. We are a warm one. They are not the same thing.
